info.name: GigSky Enterprise & IoT API
info.description: GigSky operates account-gated RESTful APIs for enterprise/IoT and partner/reseller customers via the GigSky Enterprise Manager (GEM) and IoT SIM Management portal. GigSky does NOT publish a public API reference: no base URL, endpoints, schemas, or authentication scheme are publicly documented as of 2026-06-21. This collection contains no executable requests because no endpoints are documented; the folders below mirror the conceptual API surfaces (Plans/Catalog, eSIM Provisioning, Orders, Usage) and the {{baseUrl}} variable is an illustrative, unverified placeholder. Reconcile against partner documentation obtained directly from GigSky.

variable.description: Illustrative, UNVERIFIED base URL. GigSky does not publish an official API host publicly.

item.name: Plans & Catalog
item.description: Conceptual surface for browsing regional/global eSIM data plans by destination and price zone. No endpoints are publicly documented.

item.name: eSIM Provisioning
item.description: Conceptual surface for eSIM/SIM provisioning, connectivity control, limits, sub-accounts, and OTA provisioning via GEM / IoT portal. No endpoints are publicly documented.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Conceptual surface for partner/enterprise order placement and fulfillment. No endpoints are publicly documented.

item.name: Usage
item.description: Conceptual surface for data-consumption and connectivity usage reporting per SIM, user group, sub-account, or pooled plan. No endpoints are publicly documented.
